context: This evaluation assesses how well the engineer uses the @repo/typescript-config package to create appropriate TypeScript configurations for different project types in a monorepo. The focus is on correctly extending the provided configuration presets (base.json, nextjs.json, react-library.json) and understanding which preset to use for each project type.

checklist.name: Backend extends base.json
checklist.description: The tsconfig.backend.json file uses the 'extends' field to properly extend '@repo/typescript-config/base.json' (or './node_modules/@repo/typescript-config/base.json' or similar valid path)

checklist.name: Backend compiler options
checklist.description: The tsconfig.backend.json includes compilerOptions with outDir set to './dist' and rootDir set to './src'

checklist.name: Backend Node.js types
checklist.description: The tsconfig.backend.json includes types for Node.js, either through compilerOptions.types array including 'node', or through a types field, or by ensuring @types/node is available

checklist.name: Next.js extends nextjs.json
checklist.description: The tsconfig.next.json file uses the 'extends' field to properly extend '@repo/typescript-config/nextjs.json' (or './node_modules/@repo/typescript-config/nextjs.json' or similar valid path)

checklist.name: Next.js includes src
checklist.description: The tsconfig.next.json includes an 'include' array that contains './src' or 'src' or similar path to include the source directory

checklist.name: Next.js excludes node_modules
checklist.description: The tsconfig.next.json includes an 'exclude' array that contains 'node_modules' to exclude dependencies from compilation

checklist.name: Library extends react-library.json
checklist.description: The tsconfig.library.json file uses the 'extends' field to properly extend '@repo/typescript-config/react-library.json' (or './node_modules/@repo/typescript-config/react-library.json' or similar valid path)

checklist.name: Library compiler options
checklist.description: The tsconfig.library.json includes compilerOptions with outDir set to './lib' and rootDir set to './src'
